121 PM PST Tue Nov 17 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1008 mb low was over Salt Lake City, and a 1024 mb 
high located about 750 nautical miles southwest of San Diego, CA.
Northwest winds of 25-30 kt gusts expected, with steep, high seas
of 6-10 feet for today, which will gradually come down later this
evening. 

A break in hazardous conditions can be expected Wednesday. 
Conditions look to deteriorate once again come Thursday as the 
next storm system approaches. There is a 10-15 percent chance of 
thunderstorms over the coastal waters Tuesday morning. If any 
thunderstorms occur, they will be capable of producing 
gusty/erratic winds and lightning, with a slim chance of an 
isolated waterspout. Calmer winds and seas expected this weekend.

$$
